text:
Type: grey wool throw with fringe
Use: covering a sofa, an armchair or a bed, keeping warm; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, traditional, rustic
Materials: soft brushed wool-blend weave with a small jacquard pattern, knotted fringe ends
Colors: medium grey, light heather grey
Shape: long rectangular throw with an allover small diamond lattice pattern, fuzzy surface, fringed short edges, drapes softly when folded
Feel: cozy, warm, soft, wintry
Goes with: white or cream sofas, light wood, sheepskin, grey tones; Scandinavian, cabin or rustic rooms

product.name: GRFIBBLA
product.description: Made of pure new wool, the throw is soft and cushiony to the touch and long lasting.
